import random

def _t():
    g = random.Random()
    x = [g.random() for i in range(50)] + [0.0] * 5
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.uniform(1, 10)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.paretovariate(1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.expovariate(1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.expovariate()
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.weibullvariate(1.0, 1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.vonmisesvariate(1.0, 1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.normalvariate(0.0, 1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.gauss(0.0, 1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.lognormvariate(0.0, 1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.vonmisesvariate(0.0, 1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.gammavariate(0.01, 1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.gammavariate(1.0, 1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.gammavariate(200.0, 1.0)
    g.random = x[:].pop
    g.betavariate(3.0, 3.0)

    g.triangular(0.0, 1.0, 1.0 / 3.0)

    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))

import random
from collections import abc, Counter

def _t():
    B = random.binomialvariate
    try:
        B(n=-1)
    except ValueError as _exc:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('assertRaises: did not raise')
    try:
        B(n=1, p=-0.5)
    except ValueError as _exc:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('assertRaises: did not raise')
    try:
        B(n=1, p=1.5)
    except ValueError as _exc:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('assertRaises: did not raise')
    assert B(0, 0.5) == 0, ('assertEqual', B(0, 0.5), 0)
    assert B(10, 0.0) == 0, ('assertEqual', B(10, 0.0), 0)
    assert B(10, 1.0) == 10, ('assertEqual', B(10, 1.0), 10)
    assert B(1, 0.3) in {0, 1}, ('assertTrue', B(1, 0.3) in {0, 1})
    assert B(1, 0.9) in {0, 1}, ('assertTrue', B(1, 0.9) in {0, 1})
    assert B(1, 0.0) in {0}, ('assertTrue', B(1, 0.0) in {0})
    assert B(1, 1.0) in {1}, ('assertTrue', B(1, 1.0) in {1})
    assert B(5, 1e-18) == 0, ('assertEqual', B(5, 1e-18), 0)
    assert B(5, 0.25) in set(range(6)), ('assertTrue', B(5, 0.25) in set(range(6)))
    assert B(5, 0.75) in set(range(6)), ('assertTrue', B(5, 0.75) in set(range(6)))
    assert B(100, 0.25) in set(range(101)), ('assertTrue', B(100, 0.25) in set(range(101)))
    assert B(100, 0.75) in set(range(101)), ('assertTrue', B(100, 0.75) in set(range(101)))
    c = Counter((B(4, 0.25) for i in range(100000)))
    assert 29641 <= c[0] <= 33641, ('assertTrue', 29641 <= c[0] <= 33641)
    assert 40188 <= c[1] <= 44188, ('assertTrue', 40188 <= c[1] <= 44188)
    assert 19094 <= c[2] <= 23094, ('assertTrue', 19094 <= c[2] <= 23094)
    assert 2688 <= c[3] <= 6688, ('assertTrue', 2688 <= c[3] <= 6688)
    assert set(c) == {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}, ('assertEqual', set(c), {0, 1, 2, 3, 4})
    c = Counter((B(100, 0.25) for i in range(100000)))
    assert 34214 <= c[20] + c[21] + c[22] + c[23] + c[24] <= 38214, ('assertTrue', 34214 <= c[20] + c[21] + c[22] + c[23] + c[24] <= 38214)
    assert set(c) <= set(range(101)), ('assertTrue', set(c) <= set(range(101)))
    assert c.total() == 100000, ('assertEqual', c.total(), 100000)
    assert 19000000 <= B(100000000, 0.2) <= 21000000, ('assertTrue', 19000000 <= B(100000000, 0.2) <= 21000000)
    assert 89000000 <= B(100000000, 0.9) <= 91000000, ('assertTrue', 89000000 <= B(100000000, 0.9) <= 91000000)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
